items.headline: Iran ka daava: do American drone giraye
items.detail: Iran ki sena aur IRGC ne daava kiya ki Hormuz ke paas America ke LUCAS aur MQ-1 drone giraye gaye; America ne abhi iski pushti nahi ki hai.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran yuddh me drone yuddh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ki dhamki: bandh-bijli ghar nishane par
items.detail: Iran ke sansad adhyaksh Ghalibaf ne kaha America-Israel ke thikanon ke paas bandh, bandargah aur bijli ghar bhi 'dual-use' mane jayenge; yeh chetavni NYT ki report ke jawab me aayi.
items.exam_angle: Iran-US tanaav aur 'dual-use' siddhant — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Iran hamla kare to bhari keemat
items.detail: Manila me Trump ne kaha agar Iran ne Washington par hamla kiya to use aisi keemat chukani hogi jo kisi desh ne kabhi nahi chukayi; White House ne kaha filhal koi pakka khatra nahi dikh raha, Iran ne aaropon ko 'bebuniyad' batakar kharij kiya.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran yuddh, dirty bomb aur rasayanik hathiyar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Jericho me golibari: 72 saal ki mahila ki maut
items.detail: Duyuk al-Tahta gaon me raat ko golibari me 72 saal ki ek mahila ki maut ho gayi aur kai log ghayal hue; Filistin adhikariyon ne basne walon par aarop lagaya, Israeli sena ne kaha pehle gaadi se hamla hua tha.
items.exam_angle: West Bank, Israeli basti aur do-rashtra samadhan — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: UK ne Israeli basti companiyon par pratibandh lagaye
items.detail: Britain ne West Bank me basti banane wali aath companiyon aur Gaza sahayata rokne wale Tzav 9 par sampatti jabti aur nideshak pratibandh lagaye; E1 pariyojana ki boliyon se pehle yeh kadam uthaya gaya.
items.exam_angle: UK pratibandh, West Bank basti aur E1 pariyojana — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Tara Gas par doosra hamla, 1 Bharatiya lapata
items.detail: Hormuz ke paas Panama ke LPG tanker Tara Gas par doosra hamla hua; 25 ka dal jahaz chhodkar nikla, 24 surakshit mile, 1 Bharatiya navik lapata hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz, tel vyapar, samudri suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Mongolia ke Rashtrapati ne istifa diya
items.detail: Bhrashtachar ke aaropon aur mahaabhiyog ki dhamki ke baad Ukhnaa Khurelsukh ne istifa diya — aaropon se inkar karte hue kaha jaanch me sahyog karenge; sansad ko chaar mahine me chunav karana hoga.
items.exam_angle: Mongolia, rashtrapati istifa aur bhrashtachar — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Zaporizhzhia par hamla: 2 ki maut, 18 ghayal
items.detail: Subah ke hamle me Zaporizhzhia ke teen jilon ki audyogik imaraton par hamla hua — 2 log mare, 18 ghayal; malbe se ek mahila zinda nikali gayi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, nagrik nuksan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Vance: Iran yuddh 'forever war' nahi hoga
items.detail: Up-Rashtrapati Vance ne Fox News se kaha Trump Iran sangharsh ko lamba nahi khinchenge — 10-15 saal to door, do saal ki pratibaddhta bhi nahi hogi.
items.exam_angle: America-Iran yuddh, US videsh neeti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: South Africa: do golibari me 17 ki maut
items.detail: Ravivar raat Pretoria ke paas jhopdi me 9 aur Pietermaritzburg ke paas gaadi me 8 log mare gaye; police ne dono hamlo ko asambandhit bataya, abhi koi giraftari nahi hui.
items.exam_angle: South Africa, bandook hinsa aur kanoon-vyavastha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Bahrain: Iran ka teesra drone hamla
items.detail: Iran ne Sheikh Isa Air Base par US radar ko nishana banaya — paanch din me teesra hamla; Bahrain ne drone roke, teesra US carrier bhi kshetra me pahuncha.
items.exam_angle: West Asia me tanav, Hormuz tel supply par asar.

items.headline: Serbia: chhatra dal ki sansad ne shapath li
items.detail: Belgrade me Serbia ki nayi sansad ki pehli baithak hui aur chhatra samarthit Student List ke 140 sansadon ne shapath li, jisse Vucic ke 14 saal ke shasan ka ant aupcharik hua.
items.exam_angle: Serbia, loktantra aur chhatra andolan — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Optimizely hack: 178 badi websites nishane par
items.detail: Optimizely platform ke zariye Zoom, BBC, CNN, HSBC aur IKEA samet 178 sangathanon ki websites par crypto aur card details churane wala kharab JavaScript daala gaya; Optimizely ne kami band kar di hai.
items.exam_angle: Supply-chain cyberattack aur digital suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ne IAEA nirikshan se inkar kiya
items.detail: Up Videsh Mantri Gharibabadi ne kaha Iran apne kshatigrast parmanu sthalon par IAEA nirikshakon ko tab tak nahi aane dega jab tak yuddh sthayi roop se khatm na ho aur America uski shartein na maane.
items.exam_angle: IAEA, Iran parmanu karyakram aur aprasar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: COP31 draft: jeevashm indhan bandi tez
items.detail: Antalya me COP31 ke pehle draft me jeevashm indhan ko tezi se band karne aur 2035 tak jalvayu anukoolan ke liye saalana $120 arab dene ki baat hai, lekin antim faisla 20 November tak baki hai.
items.exam_angle: COP31, jalvayu vitt aur jeevashm indhan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ki Washington me dirty bomb yojana
items.detail: US khufiya report ke mutabik Iran Washington me senior Trump adhikariyon ko nishana banaane ke liye dirty bomb ya rasayanik hathiyar ki yojana bana raha hai; White House ne kaha abhi koi vishwasniya khatra nahi hai, aur Iran ne aaropon ko kharij kiya hai.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran yuddh, dirty bomb aur rasayanik hathiyar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: UK me berozgari 4.6% par aayi
items.detail: ONS ke mutabik July–September me UK ki berozgari dar 4.7% se ghatkar 4.6% hui, jabki vetan vriddhi 3.5% par dheemi padi aur October me company payroll me 34,000 ki kami aayi.
items.exam_angle: UK arthvyavastha aur Bank of England — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Manila me Quad netaon ki baithak
items.detail: Trump aaj Manila pahunche; America, Bharat, Japan aur Australia ke netaon ki do saal me pehli aamne-saamne baithak — samudri suraksha aur critical minerals par charcha.
items.exam_angle: Quad — Bharat, America, Japan, Australia; Indo-Pacific aur samudri suraksha pariksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Canada-China: vyapar samjhota, tariff me katauti
items.detail: Carney-Xi mulakat ke baad China ne Canada ke suar ka maas aur seafood par tariff ghataaya; Canada ne cheeni steel par riyaayat badhaayi.
items.exam_angle: US tariff ke beech Canada-China vyapar — APEC aur vyapar yuddh pariksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Indonesia ke paas 6.6 teevrata ka bhookamp
items.detail: Banda Sea me Tual ke paas 6.6 teevrata ka bhookamp aaya, Australia tak jhatke mehsoos hue; sunami ka khatra nahi hai.
items.exam_angle: USGS aur BMKG ke alag aaklan — bhookamp mapan aur sunami chetavni pariksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Japan ne Russian vimanon par ladaku viman bheje
items.detail: Do sandehspad Russian viman Japan ke hawai kshetra me ghuse, Tokyo ne Moscow se kadha virodh jataaya.
items.exam_angle: APEC se pehle Japan-Russia tanaav — kshetriya suraksha pariksha ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Pope Leo ki South America yatra khatm
items.detail: 12 din, 50 karyakram aur 1.3 crore log — Lima me 15 lakh ki antim Mass ke saath Pope Leo ne Uruguay, Argentina aur Peru ki yatra samapt ki, phaphde ki surgery ke ek mahine baad.
items.exam_angle: Pope Leo XIV, Vatican aur Latin America — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: United Airlines me gadbad, 418 udaan deri se
items.detail: United Airlines ne kaha takniki gadbadi se uski udaanen deri se chali; FlightAware ke mutabik 418 udaanen deri se aur 21 radd hui, cyber hamle ka sanket nahi.
items.exam_angle: US aviation, FAA aur airline suraksha — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Moyale jhadap: 50,000 log Kenya bhaage
items.detail: Ethiopia ke Oromia-Somali seema vivad par Moyale me hinsa bhadki; UNHCR ke mutabik 22 October se 50,000 tak log Kenya bhaag chuke hain, zyadatar mahilayen aur bachche.
items.exam_angle: Ethiopia-Kenya seema, UNHCR aur sharanarthi sankat — UPSC ke liye upyogi.
